For each funding source, calculate the average of boxy / boxz over rows where both values are present and boxz is nonzero. Define the source’s size as its total number of joined scanspatial rows. Calculate the arithmetic mean of these sizes across funding sources. Return one row for sources whose size exceeds that mean, containing the arithmetic mean of their source-level average ratios, the sum of their sizes, and the arithmetic mean of their size minus the mean size. Do not round.

Join scanspatial to projects on scanspatial.arcref = projects.arcregistry, grouping missing projects.fundflux values together. For each funding source, calculate the average of boxy / boxz over rows where both values are present and boxz is nonzero. Define the source’s size as the number of joined scanspatial rows eligible for that ratio calculation. Calculate the arithmetic mean of these sizes across funding sources. Return one row for sources whose size exceeds that mean, containing the arithmetic mean of their source-level average ratios, the sum of their sizes, and the arithmetic mean of their size minus the mean size. Do not round.

Join scanspatial to projects on scanspatial.arcref = projects.arcregistry, grouping missing projects.fundflux values together. For each funding source, calculate the average of boxy / boxz over rows where both values are present and boxz is nonzero. Define the source’s size as the number of distinct projects represented by its joined scanspatial rows. Calculate the arithmetic mean of these sizes across funding sources. Return one row for sources whose size exceeds that mean, containing the arithmetic mean of their source-level average ratios, the sum of their sizes, and the arithmetic mean of their size minus the mean size. Do not round.
queries:
WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(CASE
      WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0
      THEN 1.0 * s.boxy / s.boxz
    END) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS source_size
  FROM scanspatial AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
mean_size AS (
  SELECT AVG(source_size) AS value
  FROM source_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(ss.avg_ratio),
  SUM(ss.source_size),
  AVG(ss.source_size - ms.value)
FROM source_stats AS ss
CROSS JOIN mean_size AS ms
WHERE ss.source_size > ms.value

WITH source_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.fundflux,
        AVG(s.boxy / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(*) AS source_size
    FROM scanspatial AS s
    JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
    WHERE s.boxy IS NOT NULL
      AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL
      AND s.boxz <> 0
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
mean_size AS (
    SELECT AVG(source_size) AS value
    FROM source_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(ss.avg_ratio),
    SUM(ss.source_size),
    AVG(ss.source_size - ms.value)
FROM source_stats AS ss
CROSS JOIN mean_size AS ms
WHERE ss.source_size > ms.value

WITH source_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.fundflux,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0
            THEN s.boxy / s.boxz
        END) AS avg_ratio,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS source_size
    FROM scanspatial AS s
    JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
    GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
mean_size AS (
    SELECT AVG(source_size) AS value
    FROM source_stats
)
SELECT
    AVG(source_stats.avg_ratio),
    SUM(source_stats.source_size),
    AVG(source_stats.source_size - mean_size.value)
FROM source_stats
CROSS JOIN mean_size
WHERE source_stats.source_size > mean_size.value
